disclosure.title: What is sent and where
disclosure.intro: The AI is only called when someone clicks an AI button. Data goes to the service below, always with the permissions of who asked: records, fields and notes that person cannot see are never sent.
disclosure.personalOn: Sent (name, e-mail, phone and other fields marked as personal)
disclosure.personalOff: Not sent (personal fields and people's names are left out)

sends.summary: Sends the contact, company or deal fields, the 10 latest notes and 10 latest tasks and, when relevant, up to 10 linked deals and people. Receives a summary text.
sends.next_actions: Sends the same data as the summary plus today's date. Receives task suggestions; nothing is created without your click.
sends.compose: Sends the instruction, the draft text and, if you tick it, the current record fields. Receives the suggested text; nothing is saved without your click.
sends.query: Sends the question and the list of filterable fields (key, name, type and options). No record data is sent. Receives a filter, which is validated and shown before applying.

disclosure.neverSensitive: Fields marked as sensitive are never sent.
disclosure.neverHidden: Fields hidden from your role and records outside your visibility are never sent.
disclosure.neverStored: Aphel does not store the text sent or the answer: the call log only has metadata (who, feature, model, tokens, duration, error).
disclosure.untrusted: AI can be wrong. Review the text, suggestions and filter before using them.
